accounting.rationale: PDF65 combines broad storage-representation latitude with a cross-reference to the storage-association restrictions of 19.5.3; the fine units avoid duplicating Clause 19.
Most facilities impose no physical storage-characteristic assumption. Tests must not infer byte order, padding, address spacing, representation or storage-unit size from this overview statement.

Programs using storage-association dependent features are governed by the restrictions in 19.5.3. The definition of storage association sequences and any concrete storage-associated observations remain with the Clause 19 catalogue.
